'''End Portal Fumes''' is a {{Rare}} [[Mixins|Mixin]] that can be brewed with a {{Item|God Potion}} to grant it an additional effect for its duration.

== Obtaining ==
=== Purchase ===
'''End Portal Fumes''' can be purchased from the {{NPCSprite|Bartender}} for {{c|150k}} once the player reaches {{Coll|Enderman Slayer VIII}}.

== Usage ==
=== Brewing ===
'''End Portal Fumes''' can be brewed with a {{Item|God Potion}} to make {{stat|soulflow}} conversions provide {{Turquoise|+30%}} more {{stat|overflow}}. This effect lasts for the {{Item|God Potion}}'s entire duration.

=== Consuming ===
If the [[Booster Cookie|Cookie Buff]] is active, '''Mixins''' can also be consumed directly by right clicking them. This will provide {{Green|3x}} their normal duration (since a Mixin can be applied to up to {{Green|3}} [[God Potion]]s). The timer is separate from the {{Item|God Potion}} timer and is paused if a God Potion is no longer active. The player cannot consume '''Mixins''' they do not meet the requirements for.

== Trivia ==
*'''End Portal Fumes''' is the only {{Rare}} [[Mixin]] that does not contain the word 'Mixin' in its name.
